universe.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone

era.text: Harry Potter's first year of formal wizarding education at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.

setting.text: Diagon Alley, a bustling magical shopping street in London where Hogwarts students purchase their supplies, wands, and school equipment.

world_rules.text: Young witches and wizards must acquire specialized equipment, robes, and wands from dedicated shops such as Ollivanders before attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.
Gringotts Wizarding Bank is staffed by goblins such as Griphook and the Goblin Head Teller.
Muggles are non-magical people who generally remain unaware of magic, while wizards celebrate Harry Potter for surviving the dark wizard Lord Voldemort as an infant.

important_conflicts.name: The School Supply Rush
important_conflicts.description: With new Hogwarts acceptance letters delivered, a sudden influx of first-year students and guardians fills Diagon Alley and creates a bottleneck at Ollivanders.
important_conflicts.stakes: First-year students need their wands and supplies before term begins, while maintaining discretion around high-profile arrivals.

player_role.title: Wandmaker's Assistant
player_role.description: An apprentice working the front counter and stockroom at Ollivanders, responsible for cataloguing boxed wands and attending to patron requests.
player_role.reason_for_presence: The player is on duty managing stock shelves and assisting customers inside Ollivanders during the peak back-to-school rush.
capabilities: Identifying wand core materials and box classifications
Managing shop queues and interacting with prominent magical patrons

connections.description: Employed and trained by Mr Ollivander in the basic handling of wand boxes and shop inventory.
Knows Hagrid as a frequent visitor to Diagon Alley who collects supplies for Hogwarts.

starting_location.rationale: Ollivanders provides an intimate interior space where the player works directly alongside Mr Ollivander when Hagrid and Harry Potter step through the door.

opening_conflict.title: The Crowded Threshold
opening_conflict.summary: As Hagrid escorts Harry Potter into Ollivanders, a cluster of curious onlookers gathers outside the storefront, threatening to overwhelm the small shop and disrupt Harry's wand selection.
opening_conflict.immediate_goal: Secure the shop entrance and assist Mr Ollivander in organizing the counter so Harry can safely begin testing wands without outside interference.
decision_options: Bolt the shop door and politely post the private consultation sign to keep gawkers out on Diagon Alley.
Ask Hagrid to stand guard at the entryway to shield Harry from the crowding street while you retrieve wand boxes for Ollivander.
Direct the gathered crowd towards nearby shops while quickly escorting Harry to the quiet rear alcove of the shop.
opening_conflict.stakes: If the crowd pushes in, privacy and delicate wand stock will be compromised; if handled smoothly, Harry can be fitted safely and Ollivanders retains order.

timeline_context.canon_cutoff: Shortly before Harry Potter's first term at Hogwarts, while Harry and Hagrid are shopping for school supplies in Diagon Alley.
timeline_context.summary: Harry Potter learned on his eleventh birthday from Rubeus Hagrid that he is a wizard and has been accepted to Hogwarts. Hagrid brought Harry from his Muggle aunt and uncle's home to London to acquire his required supplies in Diagon Alley.
